Motions for the Pro Hac Admission of Don Baur and Laura Zagar on behalf of the Alliance to Protect Nantucket Sound, Inc. for filing in Docket No. EFSB 02-2C EFSB 07-8B Cape Wind Associates, LLC.

This Memorandum, and the documents enclosed with it, because you were a party or limited participant in one of the previous Siting Board proceedings listed above. Each of these proceedings pertained to the transmission line that Cape Wind Associates, LLC and NSTAR Electric Company propose to construct on Cape Cod, to interconnect a planned off-shore wind-powered electric-generating facility to the electric grid.
